note: Stage names chosen: Beskerm / Aktiveer / Koordinasie / Verfyn / Onderhou (imperative verbs, as in English). Used everywhere; UI says 'fase' for both stage and phase.
'taping' rendered as 'kleefband' / 'kleefband aanbring'. SA physios may say 'taping' or 'kinesiologiese kleefband'. Please confirm preferred term.
'elastic therapeutic tape' = 'elastiese terapeutiese kleefband'; 'patch-test' rendered as testing on the forearm for a skin reaction.
'voluntary movement' = 'willekeurige beweging' (standard physiology term, but lay readers may read 'willekeurig' as 'random'). Consider 'doelbewuste beweging'.
'willekeurige beweging' for voluntary movement: same concern as programme.stages.2.focus.f1.
'call your local emergency number' kept generic ('u plaaslike noodnommer').
'moisture chamber' = 'vogkamer'; 'eye shield' = 'oogskerm'. Unsure of established SA term.
'Ringing in the ear' = 'gesuis in die oor' (lay term).
'Zygomatic line' = 'Zigomatiese lyn': may be too technical for patients.
'Cheek counter-cue' = 'Teenwenk op die wang': coined phrase, check clarity.
Letter list p, b, m, f, v, w kept as in English; in Afrikaans 'v' is /f/ and 'w' is /v/, so the list may need adapting.
'recruits the wrong muscles' = 'die verkeerde spiere inspan'.
'Small and correct beats large and recruited' paraphrased as 'groot met die verkeerde spiere'.
Tape mode labels: Rusondersteuning / Bewegingshulp / Rigtinggeleiding.
'Consultant Otolaryngologist' = 'Konsultant-otolaringoloog' (SA lay usage: 'oor-, neus- en keelspesialis').
'Subscribe' = 'Teken in'; sign-in is consistently 'Meld aan'. Consider 'Word intekenaar' if confusing.
Published English article title translated per brief rule 6; consider keeping the original since it is a citation.
German headline kept in original German (published title), so identical to source.

Role Admin = "Administrateur" (plural "Administrateurs"); admin area itself stays "Administrasie" as in admin.json. Patient = Pasiënt, Clinician = Klinikus/Klinici.
Security wording kept non-committal: "As daar 'n rekening vir hierdie e-posadres bestaan, het ons 'n herstelskakel gestuur."
Notes are part of the patient record and cannot be edited/deleted — rendered as "pasiënt se rekord"; confirm medico-legal wording.
Stage = "fase" throughout; override sentence uses "hy of sy" for the clinician.
ICU select placed after "na Palsya uitgenooi" per English order; reads naturally in both branches.
